history.event: Tyler Zachem originally starts Broad Sky Partners (COO Heidi Vanhamme has worked with Zachem since 2014).

Zachem and team join The Carlyle Group; Carlyle acquires a portion of Broad Sky's investments. Zachem spends 5+ years at Carlyle as Co-Head of Carlyle Global Partners (long-dated strategy) and Co-Chair of the CEOF (U.S. middle market) Investment Committee.
Zachem relaunches Broad Sky Partners as an independent firm with Partners Adam Glucksman, Jodi Kahn and Jonathan Marlow.

First sale date of BSP-TS, LP (Thomas Scientific deal vehicle): $236.1M sold per original Form D (Dec 28 2021), $257.1M per Jan 2024 amendment; co-invest vehicles BSP-TS Co-Invest I ($35.9M) and II ($59.6M, first sale Mar 15 2022).

Strategic investment from Capital Constellation (managed by Wafra; members incl. Alaska Permanent Fund, Kuwait PIFSS, New York State Common Retirement Fund, Railpen, Kuwait Investment Authority, AP3) announced alongside acquisition of Thomas Scientific from Carlyle, the firm's first transaction. Firm had 23 professionals.

Broad Sky Partners, LP files first Form D: $298.7M sold (14 investors), date of first sale 2021-12-31; amended to $303.7M (Apr 2023), $323.8M (Apr 2024) and $335.0M from 46 investors (Apr 30 2025). This is the main commingled fund vehicle.

Task brief states 'Fund I closed Dec 2024 at ~$137M'. NOT VERIFIED as a fund close: the only ~$137M December-2024 SEC filing is BSP-FL LP (the Frontline Managed Services deal vehicle), $136.95M sold of a $137.45M offering, first sale 2024-12-09, 21 investors, plus BSP-FL Co-Invest ($30.0M sold of $37.5M). The main fund (Broad Sky Partners, LP) reports $335M sold. Treat '$137M Fund I' as a likely misattribution of the Frontline SPV.
First exit: sale of Smith + Howard to TPG (TPG Growth) completed; ~4x revenue growth over ~3.5-year hold.

fh_opportunities.why_now: Women's was a stated use of BSP capital; apparent thin current assortment signals either a pivot or an under-exploited opportunity.
